about: Which source mod each unit file belongs to, for the editor's per-mod areas (DESIGN_SPEC 6, DESIGN_EDITOR 5.3). First matching glob wins; a file that matches none is 'main' (the main mod, Major Experimentals). Globs: '**' = any characters, '*' = any characters except '/', case-insensitive, paths relative to the mod root with '/'. Derived 2026-10-12 from the folder layout (src/donors/<fe|moo|vte>, CHANGELOG C-009..C-019) and tools/diff-vs-baseline.ps1 (ini files ADDED outside donors/ = Depache's own additions). Depache-made units inside donors/ (e.g. t3arty..t5arty, CHANGELOG C-018) stay in the donor area they extend.
